summary_md: **Victor ([@dvictor3579](https://x.com/dvictor3579/status/2116552454750023986))** is building **Dwarapala**, a self-hosted MCP inbox gate for email, WhatsApp Business and Discord where agents can read, search and draft but every outgoing message needs human approval, with a kill switch and audit log ([dvictor357/dwarapala-showcase](https://github.com/dvictor357/dwarapala-showcase)).
